cause_quote: The new `return tool.catalogMode !== "direct-only";` kept direct-only tools out of the catalog, so the existing `tool_call` miss handler directed agents to search for tools that could never appear there.
user_saw: After an agent sent a visible direct-only tool through `tool_call`, it got an unknown-tool error and was told to search a catalog that excluded the tool.
summary: The fix makes `tool_call` tell agents to invoke a direct-only tool by its declared name when that tool is visible on the current turn.
reasoning: The introducing diff defined direct-only tools as visible to the model and absent from the structured catalog. Comparing it with its parent confirmed that `tool_call` already searched only catalog entries and sent misses to `tool_search`, so the misleading recovery path existed from the first commit that supported direct-only tools.
